Features are turned on or off per scope, and locked for the scopes below. Terms are the names of things a campus can change, in each language.

## `courses`

Categories, courses, sections, groups and group sets.

### Features

| Feature | What it does | On by default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `courses.groups` | Groups and group sets in courses | yes |

### Terms

| Term | Language | Singular | Plural |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `courses.category` | en | category | categories |
| `courses.category` | es | categoría | categorías |
| `courses.course` | en | course | courses |
| `courses.course` | es | curso | cursos |
| `courses.section` | en | section | sections |
| `courses.section` | es | sección | secciones |

## `activities`

Course modules: activities and materials placed in the sections of a course.

### Terms

| Term | Language | Singular | Plural |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `activities.activity` | en | activity | activities |
| `activities.activity` | es | actividad | actividades |
| `activities.material` | en | material | materials |
| `activities.material` | es | material | materiales |
